'''ebstud19 Scum Deck V1.0''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[ebstud19]]
* '''Published:''' 6 February 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|JPSD-D-mykindofscum.gif|label=My Kind Of Scum}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' My Kind Of Scum
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 MKOS ebstud19 DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Ability, Ability, Ability (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

My first attempt at a MKOS deck.

== Notes ==

* Posted 'DVD-1 with Backup' dested OWO-1 With Backup (the only Dark '... With Backup' character); unsure.
* Posted 'Myo (Rep)' x2 dested Myo x2 as posted (unique character; '(Rep)' = MKOS representative).
* Location, Location, Location is unmarked, so the printed Dagobah effect; Ability, Ability, Ability (v) dested the VS6 slip.
* Posted 'Boba Fett, Bounty Hunte' dested Boba Fett, Bounty Hunter; 'Dr. Evanzan and Ponda Baba' dested Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba.

== Strategy ==

My first attempt at a MKOS deck. Basically a beatdown deck. Anyhelp would be greatly appreciated. I will add strategy to the post later...doing this during class. LOL
